hero.headline: Here’s a snapshot of your kitchen

about.label: About your household
about.big: A family of four across three generations, with one vegetarian, one peanut allergy and very different breakfasts every morning
about.small: Test copy to check that a long intro still fits

household.title: Your household
household.sub: Four of you, three ways of eating

cuisines.name: North Indian
cuisines.note: Dal, roti and a dry sabzi most days

meals.title: Your meal preference
meals.sub: Simple mornings, a packed lunch, a light dinner

items.name: Breakfast
items.what: Eggs, sunny side up or in a sandwich
items.sub: Or carrot roti and sabzi, poha, a Kerala breakfast now and then

items.name: Lunch
items.what: Chicken, prawns or fish, with rice or roti
items.sub: One of the two, never both

items.name: Dinner
items.what: Two dishes and a cut salad
items.sub: Often two curries. A different gravy from lunch

items.name: Kids' tiffin
items.sub: No peanuts anywhere in the box

notes.label: Rice
notes.sub: Basmati only for biryani. Jeera or carrot rice as the lighter rice

must: Any one dish about once a week
nogo: A plain rice thali for dinner
The same gravy at lunch and dinner

love.title: Food you love
love.sub: No one cuisine every day. These three come back

sources.title: Where your food comes from
sources.sub: Fresh only from the apps you trust

kitchen.title: For your kitchen
kitchen.sub: Packaged favourites and where not to source fresh produce
must: Rotated by the month, for the better price
Packets wiped, vegetables washed before storing
Prawns deveined when the pack isn’t
nogo: Anything fresh from Zepto or Blinkit

noticed.title: The little thing we noticed
noticed.sub: Just the way each of you likes it

rules.title: Rules of the house
rules.sub: Nothing goes to waste or stays past its expiry

facts.sub: Reheated. Rice can become fried rice
Of dinner can be made in the morning

must: Wipe the counter and any spill
nogo: Anything kept close to a week

closing.title: This is your kitchen as we know it
closing.text: If we’ve missed anything or something changes, just let us know
closing.cta: Drop us a voice note or a simple text and we’ll fix it
